Patient_Answer: Good morning, Doc. I want to consult, my chest feels uncomfortable again.
Doctor_response: Morning, Sir. How does it feel uncomfortable? Is it sharp pain or like being pressed by a heavy object?

Patient_Answer: It feels heavy, Doc, like an elephant is sitting on it. It's been coming and going for 2 days. I'm afraid of another heart attack like last year.
Doctor_response: Okay, are you still regularly taking the blood thinner Aspirin that I prescribed?

Patient_Answer: Still am, Doc, Aspirin regularly every morning. But for these past 3 days, my molar has been hurting badly, throbbing all the way to my head.
Doctor_response: Then what medicine did you take for the toothache?

Patient_Answer: I bought Ibuprofen at the stall, Doc. I take it 3 times a day so the pain goes away. It's quite effective.
Doctor_response: Oh my, Sir, this is dangerous. You're taking Aspirin combined with Ibuprofen?

Patient_Answer: Yes, Doc, I didn't know. Is it not allowed?
Doctor_response: That is dangerous, Sir. Both are hard on the stomach. If combined, the risk of stomach bleeding is very high, and Ibuprofen blocks the Aspirin from protecting your heart.

Patient_Answer: Doc, look at my feet, they are swollen very big. If pressed, the skin doesn't bounce back.
Doctor_response: Oh yes, that's swollen (edema), Ma'am. How is your breathing? Are you short of breath if you walk to the bathroom?

Patient_Answer: Yes Doc, gasping for air. I also have to sleep using 3 pillows, if I lie flat it feels very tight (orthopnea).
Doctor_response: You have a history of Heart Failure, right? Are you taking your Furosemide regularly?

Patient_Answer: That's the thing, Doc, my Furosemide ran out since Sunday. I was too lazy to go to the pharmacy so I haven't taken it for 4 days.
Doctor_response: No wonder, Ma'am. Furosemide is a diuretic. If you stop, the fluid accumulates in your legs and lungs, that's why you are short of breath.

Patient_Answer: Oh my, I thought it was okay to stop for a bit.
Doctor_response: You cannot, Ma'am. For heart failure, it's a lifetime medication. I will prescribe it again, please get it filled immediately.

Patient_Answer: Doc, I feel very weak this week. My weight dropped 3 kilos even though I eat a lot.
Doctor_response: Any other complaints, Sir? Often thirsty or frequent urination at night?

Patient_Answer: Yes, that's right Doc! At night I can wake up 5 times to pee. My throat is dry so I keep drinking glasses of water.
Doctor_response: You have a history of Diabetes, right? Do you still have your Metformin?

Patient_Answer: Still have it Doc, but honestly I often forget to take it. Sometimes I remember, sometimes I don't. My stomach also feels bloated if I take it.
Doctor_response: What was your last fasting blood sugar check, Sir?

Patient_Answer: This morning I checked at my neighbor's house just to see, the number was 350, Doc.
Doctor_response: Wow, 350 is very high Sir, dangerous. Metformin must be taken regularly to control sugar. If you feel bloated, I will adjust how you take it to be after meals.

Patient_Answer: Doc, please help my child. His body has been very hot since yesterday afternoon, he's fussy and doesn't want to sleep.
Doctor_response: How old is the child, Ma'am? Have you measured the temperature?

Patient_Answer: 4 years old, Doc. This morning his temperature was 39.5 degrees. I gave Paracetamol syrup but it only went down for a moment, then went up again.
Doctor_response: Is there any cough, runny nose, or diarrhea?

Patient_Answer: No cough, Doc. But he keeps holding his right ear while crying.
Doctor_response: Okay, there is likely an infection in the middle ear (Otitis Media). Paracetamol alone is not enough if the infection is bacterial. I will check his ears later.

Patient_Answer: Doc, please look at my skin. Red itchy bumps have appeared all over my body, Doc.
Doctor_response: When did it start appearing, Sir? Did you just eat shrimp or seafood?

Patient_Answer: I didn't eat seafood, Doc. This appeared 30 minutes after I took the Antibiotic Amoxicillin from the clinic.
Doctor_response: Have you taken Amoxicillin or Penicillin medication before?

Patient_Answer: Never before Doc, this is the first time. My lips also feel a bit thick and my breathing is a bit heavy, Doc.
Doctor_response: Stop! Do not take it again, Sir. You seem to have a severe allergy to Penicillin. Your symptoms point to anaphylaxis, this is an emergency.

Patient_Answer: The world feels like it's spinning, Doc. Very nauseous, if I open my eyes I feel like falling.
Doctor_response: Spinning dizziness (Vertigo), right? How long has it been, Ma'am?

Patient_Answer: Since waking up yesterday, Doc. I tried taking my husband's leftover Betahistine from last month.
Doctor_response: What dosage did you take? How many times a day?

Patient_Answer: I don't know the dosage Doc, just round white tablets. I took 3 pills at once so I would heal faster.
Doctor_response: Oh my, Ma'am, you shouldn't do that. Betahistine dosage has rules. If you overdose, it makes your heart palpitate and your stomach hurt. Don't carelessly take other people's leftover medicine.

Patient_Answer: Doc, my whole body hurts. My arms and thighs feel aching and sore like I've been beaten up.
Doctor_response: Did you just do heavy exercise or weightlifting?

Patient_Answer: No Doc, I just work an office job sitting all the time. But the pain is strange Doc, not normal soreness.
Doctor_response: Are you currently consuming cholesterol-lowering medication (Statin)?

Patient_Answer: Yes Doc, I take Simvastatin 20mg regularly every night before sleep, for 2 months now.
Doctor_response: Okay, I suspect that is a side effect of the medication (Myopathy). Muscle pain is a common side effect of Simvastatin. We need to check CPK labs and stop the medication for a while.
